## Goal
GOAL=Repair direct OpenCode 4096 normal task-main sessions so a real trusted Session ID reaches AF without modifying OpenCode upstream, while one shared AOTA MCP child safely serves multiple Sessions with one independent AF Context per Session.

The production failure is:

```text
OpenCode 4096 normal task-main Session has a real Session ID
-> ordinary AOTA MCP transport has no trusted Session identity
-> task_main.context(bind)
-> SESSION_RECOVERY_REQUIRED
```

The Plan creates a Trusted Session Bridge and preserves the existing headless path:

```text
4095 UI / Codex
-> AF Launcher
-> OpenCode :4096
-> aota-task-main
-> AOTA MCP
```

## Scope And Context
The bridge must support multiple Sessions through the same AOTA MCP child without sharing one global bound delegate. Session A, B and C each receive an independent logical AF Context, while the existing durable context projection and restart recovery remain the source of continuity. The model supplies no Session ID and has no authority to mint identity, tokens or bindings.

The approved semantics are an independent integration repair discovered by production dogfood after Plan #003 completion. This Plan does not reopen #003 and does not replace #002.

## Confirmed PoC Evidence
```text
AF_OPENCODE_SESSION_IDENTITY_BRIDGE_POC_RESULT
PINNED_VERSION=1.18.30
PLUGIN_RECEIVES_EXACT_SESSION_ID=yes
MCP_NATIVE_META_SESSION_ID=no
TRUSTED_BRIDGE_FEASIBLE=yes
SESSION_A_ROUTING=PASS
SESSION_B_ROUTING=PASS
INTERLEAVED_SESSION_ISOLATION=PASS
CONCURRENT_SESSION_ISOLATION=PASS
MODEL_CAN_FORGE_SESSION_ID=no
OPENCODE_SOURCE_MODIFIED=no
PRODUCTION_CONFIG_MODIFIED=no
AF_SOURCE_MODIFIED=no
VALIDATED_MCP_CALL_COUNT=6
```

The PoC result is user-provided evidence, not by itself production security acceptance. If the original evidence is unavailable during construction, it must remain classified as user-provided rather than represented as an independently reproduced result.

The PoC direction is: an OpenCode Plugin obtains the real `sessionID` and `callID` from `tool.execute.before`, issues a one-time HMAC token, and uses a local Trusted Bridge for association and verification.

## Governance And Frozen Architecture
```text
SHARED_MCP_CHILD_ALLOWED=yes
ONE_SESSION_ONE_LOGICAL_AF_CONTEXT=yes
PHYSICAL_ONE_CHILD_PER_SESSION_REQUIRED=no
SESSION_ID_VERIFIED_PER_INVOCATION=yes
MODEL_SUPPLIES_SESSION_ID=no
MODEL_MINTS_AUTHORITY=no
TOKEN_IS_PROJECT_AUTHORITY=no
SESSION_ID_IS_PROJECT_AUTHORITY=no
EXISTING_DURABLE_BINDING_REUSED=yes
SECOND_SESSION_DB=no
MCP_PUBLIC_TOOL_COUNT=1
MCP_PUBLIC_TOOL=aota.invoke
SHARED_CHILD_SESSIONS_MUST_NOT_SHARE_GLOBAL_BOUND_DELEGATE=yes
```

The Trusted Bridge verifies the carrier on every invocation, correlates the verified Session identity to the call, and routes to a Session-scoped logical Context. It does not become a Project authority, a Plan authority, a Session database, or a second context engine.

## F-D Boundary
```text
FINDING_ID=F-D
FINDING_TITLE=BY_REF_HYDRATION_SCOPE_MISMATCH
CLASSIFICATION=OPEN_NON_BLOCKING_ADJACENT
OWNED_BY_THIS_PLAN=no
SOURCE_REPAIR_IN_THIS_PLAN=no
```

F-D remains a known baseline: the Session Bridge repairs caller/Session identity; F-D concerns ToolOutputRef and AuthorizedRoot hydration scope. Existing `result.hydrate` security and normal hydration must not be weakened or newly regressed. F-D is not allowed to block #004 acceptance by itself. A new hydration regression introduced by #004 must be repaired. Multi-Root By-Ref Hydration is a separate future repair Plan after #004.

## M1 - Trusted Carrier & Context Isolation Contract
Objective: Freeze trusted Session identity, Token, call correlation, Context isolation and the formal implementation boundary.
```text
M1_STATUS=in_progress
M1_DAG=W1 -> W2 -> W3 -> RV1
M1_WORK_ITEMS=W1, W2, W3
```

### M1/W1 - OpenCode Invocation Identity Reconnaissance
Confirm the pinned v1.18.30 Plugin hook, real `sessionID` and `callID`, actual MCP request shape, and directory-instance MCP child lifecycle. Record the exact trusted source and distinguish user-provided PoC evidence from independently read evidence.

### M1/W2 - Trusted Token & Call Correlation Contract
Define HMAC token format, one-time use, TTL, secret isolation, call correlation, replay prevention and fail-closed behavior. FIFO/latest-token association is prohibited because it cannot reliably correlate parallel requests.

### M1/W3 - Session Routing & Durability Design
Inventory `_UnboundAotaAdapter`, `_bound_delegate`, existing durable context projection and restart recovery. Freeze the minimum Session-scoped routing seam without introducing a second authority or a second Session database.

### M1/RV1 Acceptance
```text
TRUSTED_SESSION_SOURCE_CONFIRMED=yes
PER_INVOCATION_CORRELATION_PROVEN=yes
TOKEN_SECURITY_CONTRACT_FROZEN=yes
SECRET_ISOLATION_DESIGNED=yes
SESSION_ROUTING_OWNER_IDENTIFIED=yes
DURABLE_CONTEXT_REUSE_CONFIRMED=yes
NO_SECOND_AUTHORITY_DESIGNED=yes
M2_IMPLEMENTATION_SEAMS_IDENTIFIED=yes
```

M1 is contract/static/V1 work plus only the necessary bounded V2 proof. It does not begin source construction without explicit user approval.

## M2 - Minimal Bridge & Session-Scoped Context Implementation
Objective: Implement the Trusted Bridge and Session-scoped Context routing while preserving the existing AF Control Plane.
```text
M2_STATUS=ready
M2_DAG=W1 -> W2 -> W3 -> W4 -> RV1
M2_WORK_ITEMS=W1, W2, W3, W4
```

### M2/W1 - Trusted OpenCode Plugin & Bridge
Implement the trusted Plugin carrier, one-time token issuance and verification. Do not modify OpenCode upstream source.

### M2/W2 - Session-Scoped AF Routing
Route one shared MCP child by verified Session identity to the correct Context. Do not add a second public MCP tool or Context authority.

### M2/W3 - Durable Resume & Lifecycle
Reuse `DurableTaskMainContextBinding` and `FileBackedTaskMainContextBindingProjection`. Verify restart/resume, Session isolation, stale identity fail-closed behavior and safe in-memory Context release.

### M2/W4 - Focused Security & Regression
```text
TOKEN_REPLAY_DENIAL=PASS
TOKEN_EXPIRY_DENIAL=PASS
TOKEN_FORGERY_DENIAL=PASS
SESSION_A_B_INTERLEAVED=PASS
SESSION_A_B_CONCURRENT=PASS
CROSS_SESSION_CONTEXT_DENIAL=PASS
CROSS_PROJECT_AUTHORITY_DENIAL=PASS
HEADLESS_LAUNCHER_REGRESSION=no
CONTEXT_SWITCH_REGRESSION=no
```

### M2/RV1
Perform one integrated review of the minimal implementation, security contract, routing isolation, durability and relevant regression evidence.

## M3 - Real Production Acceptance
Objective: Validate headed, headless and multi-Session isolation through the real OpenCode :4096 path.
```text
M3_STATUS=pending
M3_DAG=W1 -> W2 -> W3 -> RV1
M3_WORK_ITEMS=W1, W2, W3
```

### M3/W1 - Headed 4096 Normal Session
Use a real normal aota-task-main Session created directly in OpenCode 4096. In short staged prompts validate `role.bootstrap`, `context.inspect` unbound, trusted Session verification, project-only bind and same-Session continuation. The LLM must not query, report or generate a Session ID.

### M3/W2 - Shared Child Multi-Session Isolation
Use one shared MCP child for Session A and B. Prove complete Context separation with interleaved and concurrent calls, cross-Session denial, child restart/resume, and record child PID/RSS and lifecycle. A resident process alone is not evidence of a memory leak.

### M3/W3 - Headless 4095 / Codex Regression
Drive OpenCode 4096 through the existing AF launcher and verify the preserved headless path.
```text
EXACT_SESSION_REF=PASS
ROLE_BOOTSTRAP_FIRST=yes
TRUSTED_BINDING=PASS
AOTA_MCP_AVAILABLE=yes
HEADLESS_REGRESSION=no
```

### M3/RV1 Acceptance
```text
HEADED_SESSION_FIRST=PASS
HEADLESS_LAUNCHER=PASS
SHARED_CHILD_SESSION_ISOLATION=PASS
CONCURRENT_SESSION_ROUTING=PASS
PROCESS_RESTART_CONTINUITY=PASS
TOKEN_REPLAY_DENIAL=PASS
MODEL_MINTED_SESSION_ID=no
DURABLE_CONTEXT_REUSED=yes
MCP_PUBLIC_TOOL_COUNT=1
```

## Validation And Stop Conditions
Validation is minimum-sufficient, bounded and evidence-based. Normal `result.hydrate` security remains intact, F-D is recorded as the known adjacent baseline, and any new #004 hydration regression is in scope for repair. No lower proof is presented as production acceptance.

```text
M1_SOURCE_CONSTRUCTION_APPROVED=yes
SOURCE_CONSTRUCTION_STARTED=yes
WORKTREE_CREATED=yes
GITHUB_CALLS=0
REMOTE_PUSHED=no
CURRENT_NEXT_ACTION=Complete M2 W1-W4 bounded construction and integrated RV1.
```
